# Sample handbook

Start with the [introduction](intro.md#getting-started) or jump to
[sealing](protect-and-finish/sealing.md#sealing-steps).

Code samples are never link-checked:

```md
[nowhere](does-not-exist.md)
```

Inline code such as `[nope](missing.md)` is ignored too.
